newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Unibanco raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Unibanco raised to buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it had upgraded Brazilian private bank Unibanco to buy from hold.

-- Recent under-performance of the preferred shares and expectations of increased liquidity resulting from an upcoming global offering were the main reasons for the upgrade, analyst Nuno Fernandes said in a report.
-- "We estimate a 130 percent increase in the bank's average daily volume to $2.8 million as a result of the ADR offering and conversion of local shares into units," he said in the report.
-- Unibanco is due to offer about $1.2 billion in Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) on behalf of the Central Bank in the U.S., Europe and Brazil.

-- After the global offering, Unibanco will allow current shareholders to exchange their preferred and common shares for units, the report said. Each GDR is made up of 500 units, which are composed of preferred shares in Unibanco and its holding company.
-- Unibanco preferred was flat at 37.50 reais earlier Monday on the Sao Paulo bourse.
